title: Speaking Practice 20 - Describe a Childhood Memory
description: IELTS Speaking Part 2: Describe a happy childhood memory.

stimuli.title: Part 2: Describe a Childhood Memory
stimuli.content:
You will have 1 minute to prepare and then speak for 1-2 minutes.

Describe a happy childhood memory.

You should say: what the memory is about, how old you were, who was involved, and explain why this memory is special to you.

questionGroups.instruction: Speak for 1-2 minutes using the prompts.

explanation.sampleAnswer: One of my happiest childhood memories is flying kites with my grandfather. I was about seven years old, and we would go to the rice fields near our village on windy afternoons. He taught me how to make kites from bamboo and paper. Those simple moments of running through the fields with the kite soaring above taught me the joy of simple pleasures.

questions.content: Do you think childhood experiences shape who we become?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Definitely. Research shows that early experiences, both positive and negative, have a lasting impact on personality and emotional development.

questions.content: Are children today having a different childhood than previous generations?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, technology has dramatically changed childhood. Children today spend more time on screens and less time playing outdoors, which has both advantages and disadvantages.
